work.summary: Changed the shared product-order priority to maker group → smaller detected container size → younger/natural product number. Maker groups remain ranked by each maker's youngest product number. The new order is enforced across Product Master, Analysis vehicle-stock cards, and vehicle stocktake. Equal-size products fall back to natural product-number order, and unknown-size products follow known sizes. Product Master copy was aligned to the new rule. No inventory movement, OCR/report confirmation, forecast, engine, DB, or schema behavior changed.
